name: engineering-catalog
description: AI engineering catalog — skills, agents, workflows and bundles for GitHub Copilot and Claude Code

scripts.test: t=$(mktemp -d) && before=$(find "$t" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name 'node-compile-cache' | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && TMPDIR="$t" node --test test/*.test.js; status=$?; after=$(find "$t" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name 'node-compile-cache' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "before=${before} after=${after}"; node test/tmpdir-leak-guard.js "$t"; guard_status=$?; if [ "$status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$guard_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
